title: Signal: Additional index declared over cleartext
scope: A requirements.txt file that declares a requirements file that adds a cleartext extra index.
limitations: It matches a requirements file that adds a cleartext extra index in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A requirements.txt that mentions a requirements file that adds a cleartext extra index in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
